_description: Keystroke Dynamics Feature Configuration — NOVA Bank Prototype

aggregate_features._description: 13 password-independent features used by the Random Forest ML model (Signal 1). These are extracted by backend/features.py:extract_aggregate_features() and MUST be in this exact order for training and inference.

features.name: total_time
features.description: Total typing duration (last keyup - first keydown)

features.name: cv_hold
features.description: Coefficient of variation for hold times (capped at 10)

features.name: cv_flight
features.description: Coefficient of variation for flight times (capped at 10)

features.name: min_flight
features.description: Minimum flight time (0 for single-key passwords)

features.name: max_flight
features.description: Maximum flight time (0 for single-key passwords)

positional_features._description: Per-key-position features used by profile deviation (Signal 2). Password-specific — only comparable within the same user and same password. Mirrors JS extractFeatures().

risk_thresholds._description: Operational three-level decision boundaries used in the submitted prototype (backend/risk_engine.py). NOTE: model/evaluate.py uses a separate binary evaluation threshold of 0.65 for FAR/FRR reporting — that value is intentionally distinct from these operational thresholds.

combination_weights._description: Equal weighting used in the submitted prototype. Both signals are normalised to [0,1] before combination.

profile_deviation._note: avg_z / 8 subtracted from 1.0 to get similarity score. STD_FLOOR_MS=20ms prevents division by near-zero std. divisor=8 means an 8-SD average deviation → 0% match (score clamped to 0).
